title: We visit and talk.
body: We look at your floor, your menu and how a busy shift runs.

title: We digitise your menu.
body: Photos, categories, prices and notes, set up with you.

title: We set up screens and table codes.
body: We place a code on every table and test it in your evening lighting.

title: We train your team.
body: We walk your staff through the floor and stay with you for your first service.

title: You go live.
body: Your tables start ordering and we stay on call when you need us.
